background: Barclays PLC is the listed holding company of the Barclays group, a UK universal bank with a large transatlantic corporate and investment bank alongside UK retail banking and international cards.
synthesis: Rated A- on average across all three, the weakest of them at BBB+ and all three on a stable outlook, with no move since a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 19 May 2023. The ratios sit at the strong end of the UK majors: CET1 of 14.3% is in the top quarter, leverage of 4.9% is above the median, and LCR of 158% and NSFR of 136% are both above theirs. LCR has fallen 20 points since 30 Jun 2025 from a high base and the rest are broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The ratings sit lower than the ratios alone would suggest, which is the price of a large investment bank's earnings volatility; what has been flagged in the last 90 days is conduct and operational risk, a regulatory matter and repeated trading-platform outages, rather than anything touching solvency.
